name: Yuri Clicker
source: Kisara Yamashiro is a freshman at Harusaku All Girls Academy. On her first day at the academy, she gets lost and nobody wants to help her. She ends up in an empty classroom and sees a beautiful older girl, reading a book. Her name is Yuri Sasaki, a third year student. Without hesitation, Yuri helps Kisara to find the right way. Kisara is fascinated by Yuri's appearance and starts to develop feelings for her. But Kisara isn't alone, Yuri is actually very famous and popular at the academy and a lot of girls have a crush on her. One day, Kisara is brave enough to write Yuri a love letter but gets disturbed by a spectacled girl. She is Miya Odagiri, Yuri's classmate and leader of the Yuri Admiration Society. A secret club full of girls who are in love with Yuri and protect her against danger. Kisara decides to join the club to protect her beloved senpai.
translation:
Kisara Yamashiro是晴咲女子学院的一年级新生。入学第一天，她迷路了，却没有人愿意帮助她。她来到一间空教室，看到一位正在读书的美丽学姐。她叫Yuri Sasaki，是三年级学生。Yuri毫不犹豫地帮助Kisara找到正确的路。Kisara被Yuri的外表吸引，开始对她产生感情。

然而，Kisara并不是唯一喜欢Yuri的人。Yuri在学院里非常出名、非常受欢迎，许多女孩都暗恋她。一天，Kisara鼓起勇气给Yuri写情书，却被一名戴眼镜的女孩打断。她叫Miya Odagiri，是Yuri的同班同学，也是“Yuri崇拜社”的领导者。这是一个由爱慕Yuri的女孩组成的秘密社团，保护她免受危险。Kisara决定加入社团，守护自己深爱的学姐。
